qo.scope:
Qwen/DSV Q/O/LSE on real CUDA with native TCP or an explicit fake NIC.

No checkpoint is loaded. Qwen uses FlashInfer; DSV uses native byte layouts and
sparse kernels. Fake NIC/visibility cases do not validate a real RDMA HCA/CQ.

reader-lifetime.scope:
4060: actual GPU reader fence, native Mooncake payloads and cache/slot lifetime.

Tiny native byte pools and cache lock boundary; no full model or RDMA hardware.

dsv-d2d-local.scope: Group-layer CUDA probes; real transport/kernels, explicit scheduler ABI fixtures.

qwen-d2d-range.scope: Real Qwen layer-group x token-range transport; no model-weight claim.
